notes.title: Embrace the love in the new heart-warming Fuddler’s Courtship DLC - out now!
notes.content:
Dear travelers,

Are you ready for a journey of the heart? Snufkin and friends are set for a new romance-infused adventure in the novella-like Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley - Fuddler’s Courtship expansion, out today on Steam and consoles!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2875880/Snufkin_Melody_of_Moominvalley__Fuddlers_Courtship/

Join Snufkin and his best friend, Moomintroll, as they embark on a camping trip deep into the wilds before winter in Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley - Fuddler’s Courtship. 

However, what should have been a relaxing excursion turns into a chaotic journey of romance and adventure. 

Many new and old friends are set to appear, not in the least shy but charming Fuddler, who desperately needs help navigating a blossoming romance among the falling leaves of autumn. 

[previewyoutube=udehdvpGttI;full][/previewyoutube]

In the very first expansion of the popular Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley, embrace the love amongst the striking watercolor visuals of autumn in this brand-new pocket-sized heart-warming musical adventure. 


Gone camping: Once again, Moominvalley’s friends and family find themselves in need of Snufkin and his best pal, Moomintroll. Head out on this love-filled adventure with a cast of your favorite characters, and make new friends on a journey sprinkled with puzzles, surprises, and enchanting musical notes.
Pushing the right buttons: Meet the charming yet shy Fuddler and help him on a journey of the heart, exploring the complexities of love and romance as he courts Mymble, Little My’s sister.
Something’s in the air: Nature changes color as Moominvalley welcomes autumn in all its splendor. Witness the rich spectacle of nature beautifully recreated in this atmospheric Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley expansion. 

💗Fuddler, Who? Feelings, Whaaa?!💗

Love is as beautiful as a rose, but the path to winning your beloved’s heart can be thorny. That won’t stop the determined Fuddler from shyly fumbling his way down the path of romance in our Snufkin game’s new DLC, Fuddler’s Courtship. During a camping adventure, Snufkin and Moomintroll learn of the Fuddler’s affection for Mymble, and joyfully and chaotically set out to help Fuddler with his courtship.

Fuddler is a shy and sweet collector of buttons. He lives in a charming tin coffee can and wears a pan for a hat. Fuddler is not very good in voicing his feelings in front of his crush, Mymble, but tries his best to impress her. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083385/8ea1101a48bd41d40927bc8bcffcf5b25846db2b.png

Fuddler originally appears in the 1959 Moomin comic “Fuddler’s Courtship,” the story our DLC is inspired by, and it also similarly follows Fuddler’s misadventures in love. So how is he related to other Moomin characters? In our Snufkin game, you’ve met his brother Sniff, who is a bit fearful but also dearly loves his toy dog Cedric! Their father is Muddler, a scatterbrained and anxious fellow with a penchant for collecting. Sniff resembles their mother, Fuzzy, more and Fuddler takes after Muddler. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083385/d0e197ce2370b73b378064936bade0763c7dcfa5.png

When adapting this story we focused primarily on the Fuddler’s character and his sweet and clumsy way to go about finding love. As with the main game, the DLC is loosely based on stories and events written by Tove Jansson, but with our own twist and interpretations to make it into a story that works well  for a video game. Fuddler and this specific story from the comics has been one of our favorites, but we struggled to find a good way to include it within the main story. It was really hard for us to let it go, so when the main game was finished, we started playing with the exciting idea of having it added as a small addition to the game as a sort of epilogue.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083385/88659c48939ca20bb5fa34de6390c02c58c1a913.png

For Fuddler, expressing his feelings is overwhelming - especially when he’s in the presence of Mymble. All matters of the heart aren’t easy, and finding the right combination of words and actions to convey what’s stirring in your soul requires bravery and a willingness to present your most vulnerable insides for inspection. But Fuddler isn’t alone! He has friends by his side, and when playing as Snufkin, hopefully that includes you too💚

notes.title: This heartfelt novella-like story arrives Dec 17th!
notes.content:
Dear adventurers,

Love is in the crispy autumn air! Join Snufkin as he gives newfound friend Fuddler a helping hand through a blossoming romance in the upcoming Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley: Fuddler’s Courtship DLC, releasing on Steam and consoles this December 17th.  

[previewyoutube=vtWcmTV-tRQ;full][/previewyoutube]
In the new novella-like story of budding love and friendship, Snufkin and his best pal Moomintroll embark on a final camping trip before the onset of winter. 

However, the far reaches of Moominvalley’s wilds hold more adventure and surprises of the heart than either of the two could have imagined. 

What should have been a relaxing excursion in an enchanting autumn-turning nature transforms into a chaotic, love-infused journey with many new and old friends alike! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2875880/Snufkin_Melody_of_Moominvalley__Fuddlers_Courtship/

Key Features


Gone camping: Once again, Moominvalley’s friends and family find themselves in need of Snufkin and his best pal, Moomintroll. Head out on a love-filled adventure with a cast of your favorite characters, and make new friends on a journey sprinkled with puzzles, surprises, and enchanting musical notes.
Pushing the right buttons: Meet the charming yet shy Fuddler and help him on a journey of the heart, exploring the complexities of love and romance as he courts Mymble, Little My’s sister.
Something’s in the air: Nature changes color as Moominvalley welcomes autumn in all its splendor. Witness the rich spectacle of nature beautifully recreated in this atmospheric Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley expansion. 

Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley: Fuddler’s Courtship is a brand-new pocket-sized musical adventure filled with wonderful encounters, puzzles, and characters, set amongst Moominvalley’s striking watercolor visuals of autumn. 

🍂Fall🍂 into Moominvalley’s Autumn

Every season has its pace, and autumn invites slowing down. It’s the time to breathe in the brisk air,  wrap your palms around warm mugs of tea, and cozy up on the couch with a journal or… a lovely little game called Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley😉

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083385/f41bb60cc88e645f3f3919cc050a26469a59496b.jpg

It just so happens that autumn has also swept into Moominvalley! In our Snufkin game’s new DLC, Fuddler’s Courtship, the forests rustle with colorful leaves and a beautiful melancholy unique to fall. Wander in this charming storybook-like world, taking a moment to admire a particularly delightful blade of grass or swaying tree. And we hope the painting-like fall landscape in our Snufkin game offers many serene and calm viewing spots to note a lovely autumn leaf or two. 

Fuddler’s Courtship is a pocket-sized adventure bursting at the seams with a larger-than-life emotion: love. Join Snufkin and his best friend, Moomintroll, as they befriend Fuddler and assist him in the delicate matters of the heart  — winning over his beloved Mymble. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083385/f88c0a3f222553fcc0158d6c16d902eccd86bc27.png

Some may view autumn with trepidation, as it slides so easily into gloomy winter. But as Tove Jansson writes in Moominvalley in November, “The quiet transition from autumn to winter is not a bad time at all.” It’s the season to find what keeps the internal hearth stoked and what you can rely on when the world goes quiet. We hope in Fuddler’s Courtship you’ll find a similar respite in the warmth of new and old friendships, plus unexpected adventures — all set against the gentle pace of autumn, the final season before winter.

💚Thank you! A personal message from the Hyper Games’ CEO, Are💚
Wow, it’s finally out now. It’s been more than 4 years since we started tinkering with this project, and many of you here have been following the development for several years at this point. I would like to use this occasion to extend a huge thank you to every single one of you who’s been our champions all this time. Having an active community has been so heartwarming for us, and we really can’t wait to see how you all like the game. So, from everyone in our team: Thank you for being part of this journey with us!

It’s been an amazing journey in creating Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley, and we are so honored by the opportunity to create a game set in Tove Jansson’s wonderful and charming Moomin world. 
We hope Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley brings the same nostalgia and comfort to Moomin fans - as well as offering a welcoming, sweet journey to those who may be setting foot in the Moomin world for the first time! 

If you head back into Moominvalley with us, we would love to hear about your sign-plucking prowess, journey and what memories you created. Please consider leaving us a Steam review!

He finds grotesque parks, gated and patrolled, and sets on a determined mission to get rid of them. As Snufkin, you will pluck park signage, distract Police Officers, and knock over statues. And along the journey, you will also create cherished memories with critters and inhabitants in the valley - forming new friendships and delightful connections.

💗We hope our game warms your heart like a warm cup of tea or an afternoon nap with the sun shining through the window. Just like how wildflowers peek out from under melting snow or how melodies from Snufkin’s harmonica soar through the brisk night sky, we hope you all find something on the journey that stirs, and perhaps softens, your heart.💗

notes.title: 💚Everything to Know About Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley💚
notes.content:
Dear travelers,

Today we’d love to provide an overview of our game and a recap of what players can expect during their heartwarming journeys in Moominvalley!

Adventure 🏕️

Spring is here, and Snufkin is on his way back to Moominvalley. He’s looking forward to meeting his good friend Moomintroll again — but he notices radically different changes in the valley. Parks have sprung up in various locations, replacing wildflowers with concrete and songbird songs with silence.

Snufkin’s not one to passively let the valley become overrun by gated parks and rules. He decides to wreak havoc upon them by sneakily removing signs, knocking over statues, and in the end, returning nature to its wild beauty. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083385/dd7aef4a7bc7eb8eec85da05c7f530277bafd955.gif

Inspiring journey 🎵

Exploration is a key element of our open-world storybook game. Snufkin will need to make his way through various parts of the land to find parks and to confront the person behind it all, The Park Keeper.

Snufkin will travel through lush wilderness, climbing up mountain faces and running along sandy beaches. He uses simple actions to traverse and interact with the world, like pushing and pulling boulders out of the way or setting a log up across a gap. 

Snufkin will also play his harmonica and other instruments he unlocks as the journey progresses to interact with the world. A few puffs on the harmonica summons worms to emerge from their holes on the cliff face, becoming a convenient ledge for Snufkin to jump onto and off of. 

During travels, Snufkin collects a resource called inspiration. It’s necessary to raise inspiration levels in order to unlock certain areas of the world and to increase the strength of Snufkin’s musical abilities. Inspiration is generated by completing quests, dismantling parks, and from running through bushes. 

Here’s a few videos we’ve shared before on the gameplay!


 Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley - Gameplay Montage
 Befriending critters with the harmonica
 Follow Snufkin on a run through Moominvalley


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083385/aab8473d11aa3dda0677226a4106bbd8990aca99.gif

Friendships 💗

Lively and loveable friends from Tove Jansson’s Moomin world are dotted across Moominvalley. Teety-Woo, a shy admirer of Snufkin, is one of the first characters you’ll meet. Among many other characters, Snufkin will also find Ninny, the invisible girl, Moominmama and Moominpapa, and the unconfident Ghost. 

There are various puzzles and sub-quests related to characters Snufkin will encounter along his journey. For instance, he will help the Ghost overcome its doubt and regain its sense of self. From the mischievous Little My to sassy spiders, Snufkin will meet many unique and memorable characters.

Oh, and yes — the misunderstood Groke will also make her icy entrance. Although initially scary, the Groke isn’t malicious and Snufkin will reach a newfound understanding with her during his journey. 

Check out some of the character content we’ve shared before!

Moominvalley is rife with parks, police officers… and friends! Snufkin will encounter familiar and beloved faces from Tove Jansson’s stories when he’s running through the forest, scaling mountain faces, and clambering through caves. notes.title: 👀Sneaking Past Police Officers in The Parks 👀
notes.content:
Something is very amiss in Moominvalley. Strange parks with monotonous lawns, trimmed hedges, and paved roads have popped up everywhere — and Snufkin will not stand for it!

He hides in a bush. He jumps out to pluck out a sign. And another one. And then another one. The signs seem endless… and oh is that a statue? He can’t pluck that, but it’s no trouble. Snufkin knocks it over with a hearty push.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083385/a0d3266626c4f9f6ec501ef8c0ebf2a02611f313.gif

In contrast to the rest of the valley, these gated areas are devoid of joy and filled with paved pathways, perfect rows and meticulously trimmed hedges. Without Moominvalley residents and inhabitants, the parks are like silent mazes. And as Snufkin, your goal is to get to the bottom of why the parks appeared and along the way, dismantle any parks you come across. 

Out of Sight, Out of Mind

Patrolling almost every corner of the parks are Police Officers, the guards in charge of making sure no one trespasses. Snufkin will need to avoid getting spotted by them or else he’ll be booted out of the parks. He can hide behind rows of bushes and other landmarks, or use his harmonica to prompt birds to flitter around and distract Police Officers — allowing him to escape their notice. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083385/37cc4b8dab213cfb41df37699fb51ab7632b6031.gif

Snufkin is equipped with plenty of abilities to not only escape detection from Police Officers, but to also explore the valley. He possesses a hearty jump and the ability to push and pull items. He can also pick up and put down items like smaller stones, so if there isn’t a Sea Monster to ferry him across a stream, Snufkin can build his own path with a stack of nearby stones.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083385/771a42c85051185ef3f3cbc2147203d87a192abd.gif

And as you gain more inspiration throughout the game, discover through rustling of bushes and activities like plucking signs — you’ll unlock more of Moominvalley. So if there’s a specific area locked by an inspiration-level you don’t have yet, come back to it later when you’ve explored more! 

Moominvalley’s critters and inhabitants will aid you in not only getting rid of parks — they’ll also help you traverse the ledges, gaps, and lakes across different terrains. In our newsletter covering the valley’s critters and inhabitants, we introduced some of the ways they assist Snufkin in getting around the valley. Even the residents that might be slightly scary at first sight, like a certain infamous and frosty character, can lend a helping hand to Snufkin in unexpected ways. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083385/3f6d7f22c4970ea6e9ec49f08c7af32eb49a9c6a.gif

We hope the experience of exploring Moominvalley is joyful and curious, appealing to the nature of free-spirited wanderers. A hearty jump, a beloved harmonica, and an open heart is all you need to start an adventure.

notes.title: "SQUEAK": Meet Moominvalley's Small Inhabitants🐿️🐇🪱🐦
notes.content:
“When [Snufkin] reached out, someone gave a sudden shout and flashed past him and off among the firs, still crying and squeaking all the way. ‘Oh yes,’ Snufkin said. ‘Creeps and woodies everywhere. Funny how nervous they always seem to be. The smaller the jumpier.’” - The Spring Tune, Tales from Moominvalley

A rustle in the bush. A curious hole on the mountainside. A nest blocking a pathway. 

Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley is inhabited by many curious creatures - some shy, some sweet, and some, surprisingly sassy like a certain spider. Everyone, big and small, are affected by the nonsense imposed by the Park Keeper and the patrolling police — with unnatural and unpleasant parks forced upon the environment and ruining homes.  

Moominvalley’s small inhabitants can provide inspiration to Snufkin, building up his musical affinity, and some of them can assist with Snufkin’s goals of plucking signs and pushing over statues in manicured gardens. Everywhere you travel to in Moominvalley, from the beaches to The Lonely Mountains, there are helpful critters ready to say “chirp”!

🎶🎶Make Friends with Melodies… 🎶🎶

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083385/8312a9752c0822994dd1e855698f257a6990b7d0.gif

Snufkin can befriend many small inhabitants with a song or two on his harmonica. Earning the help of creatures is important to traversing Moominvalley. Is a ledge too high to jump over and are there suspiciously creep-sized outlines engraved on the ledge? Then there may be nearby Creeps Snufkin can charm with his harmonica to help boost him up. 

And sometimes if a ledge is extra tall… you’ll need extra Creeps. You’ll need to search for each of them, but they’ll be happy enough to help you with ledges. Creeps aren’t the only ones you can ask for help as Snufkin. 

Wriggly worms can aid in hopping across gaps and Sea Creatures will agree to ferry you across lakes

🎶🎶…But You’ll Need Inspiration!🎶🎶

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083385/2daee55074aa6af5747f8a913a05283100c58381.gif

But in order to befriend critters in the game, Snufkin needs certain levels of inspiration. Interacting with Moominvalley’s wildlife is one way to increase Snufkin’s inspiration levels - so don’t be shy about getting to know the creatures. You are playing as the great wanderer after all. Nature and its inhabitants will be important friends in helping dismantle offensive parks and restoring Moominvalley to its former natural and harmonious state. For example,  birds can help you distract police officers either by squawking or crashing into them, as directed by the harmonica’s tunes.

🕷️🕷️“Bullies. I was here first.” - Spider🕷️🕷️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083385/198e0aa2a363eb504cbc16bff7dd7c241d3ee930.jpg

Aside from getting rid of parks together, Snufkin will also meet other unique creatures - like the dramatic spider. Although seemingly very good at holding grudges once slighted, the spider will forgive you under specific circumstances. The way to a spider’s heart is through… ? 

You’ll need to play our game, Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley, to find out!

notes.title: Wandering the Wilds🍃
notes.content:
“Walking had been easy, because his knapsack was nearly empty and he had no worries on his mind. He felt happy about the wood and the weather, and himself. Tomorrow and yesterday were both at a distance, and just at present the sun was shining brightly red between the birches, and the air was cool and soft.

It’s the right evening for a tune, Snufkin thought. A new tune, one part expectation, two parts spring sadness, and for the rest, just the great delight of walking alone and liking it.” - The Spring Tune, Tales from Moominvalley

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083385/01a452d71ec09b76cf119a66d776b81e5e57e48e.gif

In the heart of a beautiful realm, you find Snufkin wandering old paths through the thick canopy of ancient trees where rays of sun cast a mesmerising dance of shadow and light. The air is alive with a symphony of harmony and a welcoming, serene feeling that Snufkin is familiar with. We have entered the outskirts of Moominvalley, the Wild Country.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083385/bcce86667e034fe554747fd6f079a8403147b99c.jpg

“The Wild Country“ (or Ödemarken in Swedish) is what Tove Jansson called the wild and nameless area across Moominvalley’s surrounding mountains. While we don’t know exactly what Snufkin is doing all winter, the short story “The Spring Tune” gives a few clues, as it follows Snufkin on a walk through the wilderness, in search of inspiration for a new melody. 

This is where Snufkin’s story in our game begins. When he arrives in spring, you find a soft cover of snow, like a blanket covering parts of the landscape, with trees and flowers slowly awakening. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083385/935c6bd6f5f9f25c36a1205f863c85b4f27057e2.jpg

Bringing the characteristics of the landscape to life
Your travels as Snufkin will take you from breathtaking vistas to dark caves. The landscape with its rocky faces, rugged slopes, and paths… and even the sun itself feels alive, as if you can reach out and touch it, and then it will suddenly smile back at you, or give another meaningful response. Tove Jansson was a wonderful artist and seemed to enjoy painting large natural landscapes and vistas with her distinct visual style. While we don’t try to mimic the style directly, it’s important to us that the game has a similar vibe - and that everything feels like it was Jansson’s hands where the ideas were born.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083385/ab5b564974fc2a63f18e54548f8b93fd75b857b6.jpg

Nordic harmony
What’s guiding and inspiring us to create and realise these amazing stories and places is the place from which Tove Jansson also drew inspiration - the beauty of the Nordic landscape.  The Finnish archipelago was one of her favourite destinations, and together with her partner Tuulikki Pietilä they spent nearly 30 summers on the island of Klovharu. The island life was inspirational for the artists and the way of living in Moominvalley is a lot influenced by the harsh Finnish nature and the life the couple lived close to the sea.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083385/cb9173f11ee292441261a18278b021cfd38885c4.gif
